item.title: fix: archived channel sessions resume on new messages (#125163)
item.summary: fix: archived channel sessions resume on new messages (#125163) * fix: resume archived channel sessions on new messages Restore deterministic external channel routes when a newly admitted user message reaches an archived session, while preserving fail-closed lifecycle guards for internal and native-command work. * fix: restore archived sessions before reply admission Move deterministic channel restoration to the pre-dispatch lifecycle owner so admitted human messages can resume archived routes before reply-operation guards run. Also make the SQLite retention probe exit after flushing its isolated result. * fix(reply): preserve plugin-bound archive ownership * fix(reply): preserve cloud placement archive safety * fix(gateway): keep archive placement helper internal * fix(gateway): preserve placement preflight ordering
